meta.title: Card refresh returns other companies' events when given their ids
gaps: Cannot send raw foreign event ids 1–5 because no matching operation or library case is available.
Cannot verify that cards contain no other companies' titles, ref ids, creator names, or company fields because the card response fields are not available.
The available library case uses a bogus UUID rather than foreign event ids.
the case reads as “it is accepted”, but the plan checks “the app answers without a server error”

words.preconditions: A buyer signed in to the client under test (no event is built).
steps: The buyer sends the request that reads the event, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
